title: CS 4535: First Implementation Ticket, Review-Ready
description: Due Thu Oct 29, 10:30 ET, before Demo Day 2. About 5 minutes once your PRs are open.
completedHtml:
Submitted.

Your two reviewers get a GitHub review request on Oct 29. Answer each review within 48 hours. Jon merges once both reviews are addressed, by Wed Nov 4.

elements.name: intro
elements.html: This is how your reviewers get assigned, so the links have to be right. Review-ready means steps 1 to 5 are done on every PR in the stack: CI green, a description that says what, why and how you tested, tests where the change warrants them, and a rollback sentence. See What end to end means.

elements.name: issue_url
elements.title: Link to your ticket's issue
elements.description: The issue where your scope was agreed.

validators.text: Paste the full link to an issue on pawtograder/platform, such as https://github.com/pawtograder/platform/issues/977

elements.name: pr_urls
elements.title: Links to your PRs, one per line, in the order they merge
elements.description: One line if it's a single PR. For a stack, put the PR that merges first at the top.

validators.text: One PR link per line, such as https://github.com/pawtograder/platform/pull/1090

elements.name: ready
elements.title: Is every PR in the stack review-ready?

choices.text: Yes: CI green, described, tested, with a rollback sentence

elements.name: not_ready
elements.title: What's missing, and when will it be ready?
elements.description: Your reviewers start today either way. Say it on the issue too.

elements.name: scope_change
elements.title: Did the scope change from what was agreed on the issue?
elements.description: Optional. If you scoped down, link the comment on the issue that says why.
